alternatives.option: dumping complete UI code into the plan

context: Wrote the implementation plan for the dashboard scale redesign (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-09-dashboard-scale-redesign.md): 17 tasks across 5 phases — server query layer + 5k fixture, index store + virtualized lists, canvas density timeline, graph drill-down explorer, health/scope/routing/cleanup.
rationale: correctness risk concentrates in contracts and algorithms; per-line UI code in a plan of this size would be lower quality than writing it against the pinned contracts at execution time.
summary: Plan includes full code for server endpoints and pins module contracts/algorithms (round-robin neighborhood selection, virtualization math, count-mismatch refetch) for frontend components rather than dumping complete UI code into the plan
